plan.title: bug(swarm): cohort review verifier diverges from pr:merge-ready on absent Greptile

narratives.Description: bug(swarm): cohort review verifier diverges from pr:merge-ready on absent Greptile
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

`deft swarm:verify-review-clean` diverges from the canonical `deft pr:merge-ready` decision when Greptile has not posted a rolling-summary verdict.

In a consumer repository with no Greptile installation, a PR can be current-head `MERGEABLE`, have `mergeStateStatus: CLEAN`, and pass every required check. `deft pr:merge-ready` correctly exits 0 through the #2260 `verdict-absent` mergeability reconciliation, while `deft swarm:verify-review-clean` exits 1 because it directly parses and evaluates Greptile evidence and never invokes the canonical reconciliation.

## Reproduction

1. Use a PR with no Greptile rolling-summary comment.
2. Ensure GitHub reports `mergeable: MERGEABLE`, `mergeStateStatus: CLEAN`, and all required checks pass.
3. Run `deft pr:merge-ready <PR> --repo <OWNER/REPO> --json`.
4. Run `deft swarm:verify-review-clean <PR> --repo <OWNER/REPO>`.

Observed:

- `pr:merge-ready`: exit 0, `merge_ready: true`, `via: primary`, override reason `verdict-absent`.
- `swarm:verify-review-clean`: exit 1, cohort blocked because the Greptile verdict is absent.

## Root cause

`packages/core/src/swarm/verify-review-clean.ts` duplicates the older `fetchPrHeadSha` + `fetchGreptileCommentBody` + `parseGreptileBody` + `evaluateGates` path. It does not use `computeGateResult`, which owns the #2260 GitHub-mergeability reconciliation and the canonical CI, SLizard, fallback, and fail-closed semantics.

## Expected behavior

The cohort verifier and `pr:merge-ready` should share one readiness computation for each PR:

- Missing or stale Greptile evidence may be reconciled only when GitHub reports the exact PR head mergeable and clean and required checks pass.
- Genuine current-head P0/P1 findings, an errored verdict, low confidence, unresolved blocking review threads, CI failures, or a non-clean/non-mergeable GitHub state remain blocking.
- `fallback2` and `error` results remain non-clean.
- Cohort text and JSON expose the decision path and any mergeability override so a CLEAN result never fabricates or implies reviewer evidence.
- Existing `--skip-ci`, `--skip-slizard`, and ignored-check behavior remains intact.

## Acceptance criteria

- Add a regression test showing an absent Greptile verdict plus clean GitHub mergeability and green required checks produces a clean cohort through the same #2260 override used by `pr:merge-ready`.
- Add negative tests proving fallback/error and genuine blocking review findings still fail closed.
- Cohort output identifies the canonical gate path and override basis.
- Existing swarm review-clean tests and the full project check pass.

Related: #2260, #1364.
